description: This file is a shell script designed for performance testing Git repository operations, including ref enumeration, commit graph analysis, and reachability assessments, using a series of test cases and helper functions.

methods.name: test_perf_large_repo
methods.description: Runs performance tests on a large repository setup, including creating refs, tags, and testing reachability and merge status.

methods.name: test_perf
methods.description: Executes specific performance test cases, such as counting ahead-behind commits, checking for merge containment, and verifying base commits.
